summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, returning True or False, with the required docstring warnings; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for SET_WINDOW_TITLE; CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and mypy are unverified. Nothing was committed.
